# Oxygen UI

> React components for healthcare interfaces, typed to FHIR R4 and delivered as
> source through a shadcn registry. Components take FHIR resources as props
> directly and render absence, preliminary status, restricted records, and
> critical results as explicit states rather than as blanks.

Oxygen UI is not a compliance boundary, not a medical device, and not clinical
decision support. Access control, audit, data residency, and clinical validation
remain the implementing team's responsibility.

Rules that matter when generating code with these components:

- A missing value renders as explicitly missing. Never substitute an empty
  string or a dash.
- An uninterpreted result reads "Not interpreted", never "Normal".
- Status is never conveyed by colour alone; every severity carries an icon and a
  text label.
- Never build a Tailwind class name from a variable. Tailwind resolves classes
  by scanning source text, so a template literal produces no CSS and the
  severity styling silently disappears.

## Primitive

- [Absent Value](https://oxygenui.design/components/absent-value): Renders absence as a statement. Withheld, not asked, declined, and errored are different facts and never share a dash.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/absent-value.json
  fhir: dataAbsentReason
  states: Not recorded (no reason given), Not asked, Declined to answer, Result pending, Hidden — restricted, Unavailable — system error, Not applicable
  status: stable
- [Clinical Skeleton](https://oxygenui.design/components/clinical-skeleton): Loading shaped like layout, never like a value — plus progressive sections that keep partial failure visible.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/clinical-skeleton.json
  states: Loading, Loaded, Failed with retry, Stale while revalidating, Reduced motion
  status: stable
- [Clinical Time](https://oxygenui.design/components/clinical-time): A clinical instant with a required time zone, honouring FHIR partial-date precision.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/clinical-time.json
  fhir: dateTime · instant
  states: Full instant, Day precision, Month precision, Year precision, Future timestamp, Event vs recorded time, No date
  status: stable
- [Clinical Value](https://oxygenui.design/components/clinical-value): One measured quantity, unit, and comparator as a single atomic element that cannot drift apart.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/clinical-value.json
  fhir: Quantity
  states: Numeric with unit, Comparator (<0.01), Non-numeric result, Absent with a reason, Absent with no reason, Unit missing
  status: stable
- [Concept Chip](https://oxygenui.design/components/concept-chip): A coded concept with its coding one interaction away, and honest about what is missing.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/concept-chip.json
  fhir: CodeableConcept
  states: Coded concept, Text only, no coding, Multiple codings, Unrecognised system, Outside expected value set, No concept recorded
  status: stable
- [Empty State](https://oxygenui.design/components/empty-state): Five reasons a section shows nothing. An unavailable section is never rendered as an empty one.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/empty-state.json
  states: Never recorded, Filtered to empty, Source unavailable, Restricted, Pending, Compact
  status: stable
- [Identity Token](https://oxygenui.design/components/identity-token): Compact, privacy-aware representation of a person, built around confirming rather than labelling.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/identity-token.json
  fhir: Patient
  states: Complete identity, Name not recorded, Restricted record, Deceased, Photo without consent, Name-alike collision, Masked identifiers
  status: stable
- [Provenance Tag](https://oxygenui.design/components/provenance): Who recorded this, when, from where, and whether it has been amended.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/provenance.json
  fhir: Provenance
  states: Clinician-entered, Patient-reported, Device-recorded, Interface feed, Amended, Source not recorded, Charted after the event
  status: stable
- [Reference Range](https://oxygenui.design/components/reference-range): Positions a result against its own range, and refuses to draw when no bound was stated.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/reference-range.json
  fhir: Observation.referenceRange
  states: Bounded range, One-sided range, No range available, Value off scale, Text-only range, No value
  status: stable
- [Status Badge](https://oxygenui.design/components/status-badge): The shared severity chip. Critical reads identically on a lab result, a medication, and an allergy.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/status-badge.json
  states: Critical, High, Low, Normal, Unknown, Neutral
  status: stable

## Clinical

- [Allergy List](https://oxygenui.design/components/allergy-list): Criticality and verification status, with no-known-allergies as its own state.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/allergy-list.json
  fhir: AllergyIntolerance
  states: High risk, Severe / moderate / mild reaction, Risk not assessed, Unconfirmed, Refuted, Inactive, No known allergies, Not recorded
  status: stable
- [Appointment Card](https://oxygenui.design/components/appointment-card): Booked, pending, cancelled, no-show. Time zone is a required prop, not a guess.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/appointment-card.json
  fhir: Appointment
  states: Booked, Pending, Arrived, Checked in, Completed, Cancelled, No-show, Waitlisted, Virtual, In person
  status: stable
- [Care Team Panel](https://oxygenui.design/components/care-team): Everyone involved, and who is actually reachable now.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/care-team.json
  fhir: CareTeam
  states: Current team, Covered member, Past members, Non-clinical members, No team recorded, Role not recorded
  status: stable
- [Code Status](https://oxygenui.design/components/code-status): Resuscitation status and directives. Unknown is loud, never a silent default to full code.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/code-status.json
  fhir: Consent
  states: Full code, DNR, DNR / DNI, Comfort measures, Not on file, Verification stale, Conflicting directives
  status: stable
- [Condition List](https://oxygenui.design/components/condition-list): Problem list that separates active from resolved and never promotes a provisional diagnosis.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/condition-list.json
  fhir: Condition
  states: Active, Recurrence, Remission, Resolved, Inactive, Provisional, Differential, Vague onset, Onset not recorded
  status: stable
- [Coverage Card](https://oxygenui.design/components/coverage-card): Effective state derived from status and period together — an active record past its end date reads as lapsed.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/coverage-card.json
  fhir: Coverage
  states: Active, Lapsed, Not yet effective, Cancelled, Status unknown, Masked identifiers
  status: stable
- [Dose Input](https://oxygenui.design/components/dose-input): Dose entry with ISMP formatting rules, plausibility separated from hard limits, and visible arithmetic.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/dose-input.json
  fhir: Dosage
  states: Well-formed dose, Trailing zero, Missing leading zero, Above plausible range, Above absolute maximum, Weight-based calculation, No weight on file
  status: stable
- [Medication Card](https://oxygenui.design/components/medication-card): Dose, route, schedule, and status. Held, stopped, and expired are distinct — not one greyed-out style.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/medication-card.json
  fhir: MedicationRequest
  states: Active, On hold, Stopped, Cancelled, Completed, Expired, Draft, Entered in error, No dosage recorded
  status: stable
- [Observation Trend](https://oxygenui.design/components/observation-trend): One measurement over time. Abnormality is encoded as shape and colour, and the data table is an accessible peer rather than a fallback.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/observation-trend.json
  fhir: Observation
  states: Series with a stated reference band, Series with no reference range (no band drawn, stated in the summary), One-sided reference range, Critical points present, Uninterpreted points (hollow diamond, never a filled normal mark), Observations excluded for having no value, counted not dropped, Observations excluded for having no usable time, counted not dropped, Imprecise dates marked in the table, Empty series, Table hidden, table revealed
  status: experimental
- [Patient Banner](https://oxygenui.design/components/patient-banner): Persistent identity header for a clinical screen, driven by a FHIR Patient resource.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/patient-banner.json
  fhir: Patient
  states: Complete demographics, Name not recorded, Restricted record, Deceased, Masked identifiers, Loading
  status: stable
- [Precautions Bar](https://oxygenui.design/components/precautions-bar): What staff must do before entering the room, ordered by required action.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/precautions-bar.json
  fhir: Flag
  states: Airborne, Contact isolation, Behavioral approach, Fall risk, Mobility, No active precautions, Lapsed and dropped
  status: stable
- [Observation Panel](https://oxygenui.design/components/vitals-panel): Results table with reference ranges and interpretation. Uninterpreted results stay uninterpreted.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/vitals-panel.json
  fhir: Observation[]
  states: Multi-component (blood pressure), Critical high and low, High and low, Normal, Not interpreted, No value (dataAbsentReason), Preliminary, Amended and corrected, Empty, Loading
  status: stable

## Pattern

- [Action Gate](https://oxygenui.design/components/action-gate): Two-step confirmation that names the consequence and the patient, then emits an audit event.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/action-gate.json
  fhir: AuditEvent
  states: Reversible confirm, Irreversible type-to-confirm, Hold-to-confirm, Reason required, In flight, Cancelled
  status: stable
- [Alert Banner](https://oxygenui.design/components/alert-banner): Severity tiers as an interruption budget. Only critical may take focus.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/alert-banner.json
  fhir: DetectedIssue
  states: Critical, High, Moderate, Low, Info, Dismissal with reason
  status: stable
- [App Shell](https://oxygenui.design/components/app-shell): Navigation composed from permissions, patient context as a landmark, and guarded context changes.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/app-shell.json
  fhir: PractitionerRole
  states: Role with full access, Role with limited access, No features enabled, Session expiring, Break-glass active, Mobile navigation
  status: stable
- [Density Provider](https://oxygenui.design/components/density-provider): Sets the surface contract for a subtree — spacing, target size, vocabulary and disclosure. Never which facts appear.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/density-provider.json
  states: Patient profile (roomy, patient vocabulary, progressive disclosure), Standard profile (clinician vocabulary), Clinical profile (dense, clinician vocabulary, full disclosure), Register overridden independently of density, Disclosure overridden independently of density, Nested providers, Target-size floor enforced
  status: stable
- [Error Boundary](https://oxygenui.design/components/error-boundary): Contains a failure to one section and never renders a partial record as a complete one.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/error-boundary.json
  fhir: OperationOutcome
  states: Healthy, Section failed, Critical boundary failed, Retried
  status: stable
- [Restricted Shield](https://oxygenui.design/components/restricted-shield): Redacted by default. Discloses only with a stated reason, on a timer, and can conceal that content exists.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/restricted-shield.json
  fhir: Consent · meta.security
  states: Restricted, disclosure permitted, Restricted, disclosure not permitted, Existence concealed, Disclosed with countdown, Auto re-redacted, Not restricted
  status: stable
- [Unsaved Guard](https://oxygenui.design/components/unsaved-guard): Stops clinical documentation being lost to a navigation, a patient switch, or a closed tab.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/unsaved-guard.json
  states: Clean, Saving, Saved, Autosave failed, Prompt on navigation, Prompt on patient switch, Browser close guard
  status: stable

## Block

- [Patient Snapshot](https://oxygenui.design/components/patient-snapshot): One-screen pre-encounter summary where every section carries its own recency and failure.
  install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://oxygenui.design/r/patient-snapshot.json
  fhir: Composition
  states: All sections loaded, Section failed, Section stale, Section empty, Truncated with a count, Changes since last review
  status: stable

## Machine-readable catalog

- Index: https://oxygenui.design/r/index.json
- Item: https://oxygenui.design/r/{name}.json
- Coverage: https://oxygenui.design/r/coverage.json
